title: The Greatest Computer Bug: A History!

scenes.fact: In 1947, Grace Hopper found a moth causing issues in a Harvard computer.
scenes.text: Did you know the first computer bug was a real insect?
The term 'debugging' was popularized after this incident.
Follow to stay ahead of the tech curve.
